comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into an even 3 mm sheet using a spacer-ring rolling pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level rolling over repeated passes to control deformable-sheet thickness and length.
comparison.success_condition: Sheet is at least 20 cm long, at least 90% lies within 2.5–3.5 mm, lateral thickness averages are even within 0.5 mm, and the pin is released level.
comparison.reason: It measures distributed deformable-material shaping, not coaxial tool seating, countertorque locking, or retained mechanical-stop adjustment.
